# Curve:easyMode

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Get / Set the custom curve mode (1 is easyMode / -1 not)

```lua
local easyMode = curve:easyMode([easyMode])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `easyMode` | boolean | optional |  |

## Returns

easyMode (boolean)
